Mar del Plata **never had a botanical garden**. Now it does: a living, 33-hectare
arboretum with more than **300 species**, every tree **documented and traceable**, and
international recognition ([ArbNet Level I](https://arbnet.org/morton-register/la-constancia-de-biocca/){target="_blank" rel="noopener"} · [BGCI](https://gardensearch.bgci.org/garden/7214){target="_blank" rel="noopener"}). Sustaining it and opening it to the community has a cost — and your gift makes it possible.

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Your gift goes 100% to the arboretum:** care of the collections, education, research and conservation of the natural heritage. Open data, traceable impact, no greenwashing.
:::

## Become a Friend of the Arboretum

The best way to help is a **monthly gift**: small, steady, and it gives the project
predictability. Join the community that sustains the garden.

### Friendship levels

::: grid

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-3 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm}
### 🌱 Seed
**Accessible gift**

- Your name on the site's **Wall of Friends**.
- Newsletter with arboretum news.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-3 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm}
### 🌿 Sprout
**Everything above, plus:**

- Early access to events and walks.
- Digital Friend certificate.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-3 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm style="border-top:3px solid #1E4A38;"}
### 🌳 Tree
**Everything above, plus:**

- A **guided visit** for two, once a year.
- A mention on our social media.
:::

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-3 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm}
### 🌲 Forest
**Everything above, plus:**

- Featured recognition.
- Ideal for families or small companies.
:::

:::

Would you rather support a specific specimen than give in general? You can

## What your gift funds

Every contribution turns into something concrete that improves the garden and the
visitor's experience:

::: grid

::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
🪧 **Educational signage** and species identification.
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
<i class="bi bi-signpost-2"></i> **Interpretive trails** and accessibility.
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
🌱 **Nursery and new collections**: propagation and planting.
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
<i class="bi bi-mortarboard"></i> **School scholarships**: educational visits for schools.
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
<i class="bi bi-binoculars"></i> **Wildlife monitoring** and scientific survey.
:::

::: {.g-col-6 .g-col-md-4 .card .p-3 .shadow-sm .text-center}
🪑 **Benches and spaces** for rest and observation.
:::

:::
